data.exact_reserve_text: The result reflects strong premium growth, a good attritional performance, a favourable impact of a loss portfolio reinsurance and further back year reserve releases. The 2020 and prior years of account will be impacted by the loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in 2018 and 2021 with Riverstone Managing Agency Limited (for and on behalf of Lloyd's Syndicate 3500).

data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reports that the 2021 result benefited from favourable prior year reserve experience, driven in part by a loss portfolio reinsurance arrangement and benign attritional claims development. The report notes that 2020 and earlier years of account are impacted by loss portfolio reinsurance transactions (2018 and 2021) with Riverstone which contributed to a favourable impact on prior year reserves. No explicit quantified gross prior year strengthening or release is presented in the gross movement notes; the published gross claims development table implies minimal aggregate prior year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable impact of a loss portfolio reinsurance

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note with a single GROSS figure was located. The Directors' narrative references 'further back year reserve releases' and the presence of loss portfolio reinsurance (2018 and 2021) which materially affect 2020 and prior years. A gross claims development table is present and was used as the primary numerical cross-check; that table implies essentially no aggregate gross prior-year movement for underwriting years up to 2019. The presence of loss-portfolio reinsurance and Part VII / RITC style transactions may distort simple comparisons; therefore prior year development is reported as 0.0 based on the development table, with medium confidence.
